rules.counting_unit: event records deduplicated by EVENT_ID, not distinct storms
rules.zone_events: a zone event counts once for each county the zone covers

columns.county_name: Census county name, e.g. 'Dallas County, Texas'
columns.hail_reports_1in: NOAA Hail event records with MAGNITUDE >= 1.0 inch, county rows only
columns.severe_wind_reports: NOAA Thunderstorm Wind records with MAGNITUDE >= 50 knots, county rows
columns.tornado_events: NOAA Tornado event records, county rows only
columns.tropical_events: NOAA Hurricane (Typhoon), Tropical Storm and Tropical Depression records; zone records count for every county the NWS zone covers
columns.median_year_built: ACS B25035_001E, median year structure built
columns.median_home_value_usd: ACS B25077_001E, median value of owner-occupied units, USD
columns.owner_long_tenure_pct: ACS B25038 (_007E + _008E) / _002E * 100: owner-occupied units whose householder moved in before 2000, a proxy for long tenure and built-up equity
columns.free_and_clear_pct: ACS B25081_009E / _001E * 100: owner-occupied units without a mortgage (free and clear)
